summary.intent: Perform a security review of the `feat/store-ipns-crypto-data-in-db` branch (IPNS signature/public key storage in DB), then implement all identified fixes and get the PR merged.
summary.outcome: Security review completed, all HIGH/MEDIUM findings fixed (pubKey-to-ipnsName binding, web app base64 overflow, missing publicKey on publish, server-side validation, DTO MaxLength mismatch, protobuf bounds checks), PR #448 created, all CI failures resolved, and all automated review threads addressed.

repo: @cipherbox/crypto is ESM-only (uses @libp2p/crypto, @noble/ed25519, ipns — all ESM-only packages) which breaks NestJS/Jest CJS require() — requires special tsup bundling config
tsup config must use separate CJS (noExternal: [/.*/]) and ESM (external deps) build definitions to avoid breaking Vite browser builds while fixing Node.js CJS compatibility
IPNS names are cryptographically derived from Ed25519 public keys via deriveIpnsName() — the binding check was missing on resolve, allowing key substitution attacks
The 'Verify API Spec' CI job was missing a build step for @cipherbox/crypto, causing it to fail after the new dependency was added
The API (NestJS/CJS) cannot statically import ESM-only packages — bundling all deps into the CJS artifact via noExternal is the preferred pattern over dynamic import()

code.finding: pubKey-to-ipnsName binding check added after signature verification — decodes pubKey, derives IPNS name, throws if mismatch
Spread operator on Uint8Array for base64 encoding causes call-stack overflow on large records — replaced with loop-based String.fromCharCode; also publicKey now derived and sent on publish
Server-side pubKey-to-ipnsName binding validation added on publish — rejects requests where supplied publicKey does not derive to the claimed ipnsName
Split into two defineConfig entries: CJS with noExternal:[/.*/] (bundles all deps) and ESM with external deps; clean:true only on CJS to avoid wiping CJS artifacts
Test fixture ipnsName was a dummy string — must be derived from the test public key via deriveIpnsName() or server-side validation rejects it
Verify API Spec job needed explicit `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/crypto build` step before pnpm api:generate after new dependency was added

workflow: Always verify the API starts locally (nest start) before pushing crypto-related dependency changes to CI
When bundling ESM-only deps into CJS, use noExternal:[/.*/] in tsup — but keep ESM config with external deps or Vite/Rollup browser builds will fail on Buffer/Node builtins
Derive correct test fixture values programmatically (e.g. IPNS name from public key) rather than using arbitrary dummy strings when validation logic is being added

friction: Two CI iteration cycles needed for the @cipherbox/crypto CJS compatibility issue: first attempt (noExternal on both CJS+ESM) broke Vite browser builds; second attempt (split config) worked
1Password SSH signing agent caused intermittent commit failures requiring manual retry
CI 'Verify API Spec' job failure was a missing build step not caught locally — required a separate fix commit
The base64 Uint8Array spread bug in the web app was not caught during the original PR development, only surfaced in the security review
open_items: S1: Validate signedRecord CID/sequence against DTO on publish (CodeRabbit comment — deferred, needs design decision on strictness)
S2: Enforce signatureVerified===true once all existing IPNS records in DB have signature data (requires migration/backfill first)
S3: Consistent private key zeroization (fill with zeros after use) convention across SDK crypto operations
CQ1: Extract shared bytesToBase64(Uint8Array) helper and deduplicate across apps/web/src/services/ipns.service.ts, packages/sdk-core/src/file/index.ts, and packages/sdk-core/src/folder/index.ts
